newsitem.title: TURKEY: Five injured in Turk ammunition factory blasts.
newsitem.headline: Five injured in Turk ammunition factory blasts.

text.p: At least five people were injured on Thursday in a series of explosions at a state-owned ammunition factory in central Turkey, Anatolian news agency said.
It said a blast in the hand grenades section of the factory in the town of Kirikkale was followed half an hour later by three separate explosions. Anatolian did not say why the explosions took place.
Many house and office windows were shattered in the centre of the town and telephone lines were cut off by the blasts, it said.
